applyTo: "*.html,*.css,*.js"

## Frontend Guidelines

- Use accessibility attributes (alt text, aria labels) and color schemes.
- Use responsive design for compatibility with mobile devices.
- Validate HTML structure and semantic elements


# Frontend Contribution Instructions

## Announcement Banner
- Place the announcement banner at the very top of the page, before the main header.
- Use semantic HTML and ensure accessibility (e.g., add `role="status"` or `role="alert"` to the banner div).
- Ensure sufficient color contrast between text and background.
- Keep the banner text concise and relevant.

## General Frontend Guidelines
- Use modular and scoped CSS for new features.
- Test UI changes in both light and dark modes if supported.
- Follow semantic HTML and accessibility best practices.
- Use clear, descriptive commit messages for frontend changes.
- Avoid inline styles; prefer CSS classes.
- Minimize use of !important in CSS.
- Ensure responsive design for all new UI elements.
